replacement:
The shared suite workflow does not schedule Dash0. For a manual run, set
`DASH0_AUTH_TOKEN` and set `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS` to
`Authorization=Bearer%20${DASH0_AUTH_TOKEN}`, then pass the regional ingress
URL to `--otel-endpoint`, the regional API URL to `--otel-backend-endpoint`,
and select `--otel-exporter community --otel-backend dash0`.
